literal: Shaving and lengthening are not needed, world that which is condemned having abandoned if one leaves.
translation: There is no need to shave the head or grow matted hair, if one simply abandons the conduct that the world condemns.
modern: உலகம் பழிக்கும் தீய செயல்களை ஒருவன் முழுமையாக விட்டுவிட்டால், அவன் துறவியாகத் தலைமுடியை மழிப்பதோ அல்லது சடாமுடியாக நீளமாக வளர்ப்பதோ தேவையில்லை.
explanation: This couplet addresses the outward signs of asceticism, such as shaving the head bare or growing long, matted hair. It states that these physical transformations are completely unnecessary for true virtue. The only requirement is to abandon behaviors and actions that the world condemns as wrong. By focusing on inner purity and rejecting blameworthy conduct, a person achieves true discipline without needing external costumes or rituals.
